_meta.purpose: Test fixture for the final stage of the pipeline: the render-ready shape a generated resume should take, and the input contract for the JSON-to-TeX renderer. Unlike data/master_resume.json, this file DOES contain finished bullet prose - it is the output, not the data lake.
_meta.captured_from: tests/fixtures/resume.pdf - identical to ../Resume/resume.pdf (a sibling of this repository), built 2025-09-23 from ../Resume/src/*.tex
_meta.fidelity: Verbatim. Text matches the PDF exactly, including its typos and stale facts, so it can serve as a parsing/rendering fixture. It is NOT a correct resume and must not be used as the expected output of a generator reading master_resume.json - see deviations_from_master.

deviations_from_master.issue: The Aug 2022 - Jan 2023 internship is labelled Epsilon Pvt Ltd but carries Epsilon's content under Intel's dates. Per master_resume.json, Epsilon ran 2022-01 to 2022-06 and Intel ran 2022-08 to 2023-01.
The Intel Solutions & Services India internship is missing entirely. Three employers exist; two are shown.

Qualcomm shown as a single Software Engineer role. Master records Associate Engineer 2023-01 to 2024-12, then Software Engineer from 2025-01. Collapsing is allowed by presentation_preferences, so this is acceptable rendering, not an error.
Reads 'Random Forest Classifier' (singular). The published title is 'Novel Biomarker Prediction for Lung Cancer Using Random Forest Classifiers'.
Publications are reduced to a bare venue and URL. No author lists, volumes, pages or DOIs, and first authorship on the Springer chapter is not shown.

'Integrated DETR-based table extraction and YoloV5 object detection, achieving mAP values of 84.36% and 80.92%' does not bind each figure to its model. Master binds YOLOv5 to 84.36% and DETR to 80.92%.
Typo: 'primary//secondary indexing' has a doubled slash.
Broken grammar: 'and Random Forest predict potential biomarkers'.
Typo: 'DAap' should be 'DApp'. 'Certificates' was a hyperlink with no destination in the source.
No location line. Master records Champaign, IL, USA.
Project dates are absent, which matches metadata.presentation_preferences.project_dates.
The achievements section is present and last, consistent with it being the first section to drop when space is tight.
